name: cDraw
tierReason: It creates styled 2D structures and reaction figures with text, layout tools and vector export.
summary: A Java desktop editor for creating publication-quality 2D chemical structures and reaction schemes.

license.text: GNU Affero General Public License version 3.

engine.rendering: Java2D in ChemPanel; custom SVG/PostScript generators; Ghostscript converts PostScript to PDF.
engine.chemistry: In-house PCSB code with CDK modules, MCDL, JNI-InChI and Beam.

EPS/PDF export supports only Latin and Greek character sets.
